methods.name: Frozen Source Model (Default Threshold)
methods.description: Unadapted source probabilities evaluated at default threshold 0.50 on the post-burn-in window.

methods.name: Frozen Source Model (Training-Derived Threshold)
methods.description: Unadapted source probabilities evaluated at frozen training-derived threshold tau*=0.170 on the post-burn-in window.

methods.name: Source Prior Reference (Null Adaptation)
methods.description: Logit adjustment using source training prevalence pi_source as target prevalence (identity transformation for validation).

methods.name: Unlabeled Target Soft Mean Adaptation
methods.description: Log-odds prior adjustment using unadjusted average of target prediction probabilities: pi_hat = mean(p_i).

methods.name: Black Box Shift Estimation (BBSE / Adjusted Count)
methods.description: Inversion of source confusion matrix: pi_hat = clip((mu_target - FPR_source) / (TPR_source - FPR_source), 0.001, 0.999).

methods.name: Saerens Expectation-Maximization Prior Shift
methods.description: Iterative EM algorithm estimating target class prior distribution from unlabeled target score distribution under P(X|Y) invariance.

methods.name: Bayesian Burn-in Adaptation (K=25)
methods.description: Chronological first 25 commits; 90d defect maturation queue; Bayesian Beta-Binomial smoothed prevalence (M=10) with log-odds adjustment.

methods.name: Bayesian Burn-in Adaptation (K=50)
methods.description: Chronological first 50 commits; 90d defect maturation queue; Bayesian Beta-Binomial smoothed prevalence (M=10) with log-odds adjustment.

methods.name: Bayesian Burn-in Adaptation (K=100)
methods.description: Chronological first 100 commits; 90d defect maturation queue; Bayesian Beta-Binomial smoothed prevalence (M=10) with log-odds adjustment.

methods.name: Bayesian Burn-in Adaptation (K=200)
methods.description: Chronological first 200 commits; 90d defect maturation queue; Bayesian Beta-Binomial smoothed prevalence (M=10) with log-odds adjustment.

methods.name: Bayesian Burn-in Adaptation (K=500)
methods.description: Chronological first 500 commits; 90d defect maturation queue; Bayesian Beta-Binomial smoothed prevalence (M=10) with log-odds adjustment.

methods.name: Burn-in Platt Scaling Calibration
methods.description: 2-parameter logistic calibration sigma(a * logit(p) + b) fit on matured burn-in labels.

methods.name: Burn-in Threshold Adaptation
methods.description: Threshold optimized directly on matured burn-in sample and applied frozen to post-burn-in commits.

methods.name: Delayed Online Sequential Adaptation
methods.description: Causal online queue: at each prediction timestamp T_t, update Bayesian prevalence estimate using all prior commits j < t with T_j + 90d <= T_t.
